review_notes: 60 existing definitions across nine files. Exact token checks for local-only edits, focused review for structured changes, one combined incremental build. No new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.

Evolve retains power/toughness query order, cast-time AI handling, trigger checks after callbacks and ETB counter dispatch. Thrull Parasite uses the previously reviewed activation/AI-target shape without filtering resolution targets.

Strive uses an ordinary selection/payment loop and a common marked-target cleanup. Retain cached target counts for cleanup entry, live counts during cleanup, callback-sensitive fizzle checks, first-target handling and returned target index. Natures Panoply retains live target-count reads after counter callbacks.

Scale Blessing and Drana use sizeof-based clears of the same 151-byte marking buffers, preserve marking before applying counters, and retain next-card snapshots where recovered. Avatar retains its self counter query before exclusion.

Oblivion Stone retains two nonland-permanent scans and the intervening executable callback, with cached next-card positions. Catacomb Sifter uses the previously reviewed GFP lifecycle. Rescue, Incendiary, Archery Training and Earthen Arms simplify clear event/target branches.

Larger Glissa, Kira, storage-land, aura, modal AI and sacrifice paths retain their flow under token substitution. Merseine pointer-typed cost bits are named without a representation change. Zadas documented native non-advancing copy loop is preserved. Full audits, inventory regeneration and reccmp remain deferred.
verification_policy: Affected-file hashes and exact token checks for alpha-only edits; focused review for structured edits. Build separately after the combined batch. Inventories and reccmp deferred to a larger checkpoint.
scope: Readability cleanup of existing recovered definitions; no new native coverage or gameplay-equivalence claim.
